score_definition.interval: Gneiting-Raftery interval score: width + 2/alpha * interval miss distance
score_definition.zero_change_prob_skill: 1 - Brier_model/Brier_statistical; statistical not always generic market consensus
score_definition.notes: Comparative MAE/RMSE and interval scores aggregated only within units; 8 A, 5 B, 10 C; risks B deterministically derived from C and must not be counted independent. Source inconsistencies provisional. Uncalibrated probabilities and correlated outcomes.
